subject: Incentive approval for Grosvenor conversion credit
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: authorize one-time conversion credit for Grosvenor

Hi Sean / Ben,

Grosvenor (DEAL-3942) is on the fence for final sign-off. Champion (Anne) confirmed a procurement slot this week if we can greenlight a one-time credit to cover expected overage during their pilot-to-paid conversion. Ask: authorize a $12k credit applied to first-month usage and a 14-day trial extension to mitigate ramp timing.

Why this is time-sensitive:
- They committed to a 3-week evaluation but procurement needs usage headroom during final tests.
- Competing vendor bid surfaced yesterday; Anne asked for a commercial sweetener.

Attachments: deal-summary-grosvenor.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes ARR math and expected run rate.

If you can approve, I’ll send a short formal offer and route to procurement. I recommend a capped credit tied to first invoice and a clause disallowing double-crediting for later promos.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: authorize one-time conversion credit for Grosvenor

Vanessa — thanks for the context and the attachment. Quick thoughts:
- $12k sounds reasonable vs. expected 3-month value, but I want a hard cap and a usage breakpoint (e.g., credit only applies up to X tokens).
- Approve on the condition we add a 60-day clawback if they churn before full deployment (standard).

Ben — you good to sign off on the accounting side if we formalize the credit structure?

If yes, Vanessa proceed to legal/commercial template and loop procurement.

Sean
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anne Grosvenor <anne.grosvenor@grosvenortech.com>
Cc: procurement@grosvenortech.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood incentive offer for Grosvenor evaluation (formal)

Hi Anne — great talking this morning. Per our conversation and internal approval, we can offer the following:

Summary of incentive:
- One-time usage credit: $12,000 applied to your first full invoice post-conversion.
- Trial extension: 14 additional trial days (no charge) tied to this evaluation window.
- Credit cap: applies up to 250M generated tokens; any usage beyond that will be billed as standard.
- Clawback: standard 60-day credit recoup if contract is terminated for convenience during initial deployment.

I’ve attached the incentive terms for your procurement team: grosvenor-incentive-terms-v1.pdf (pdf). If this aligns, please confirm via reply and I’ll generate the formal DocuSign for signature and route to billing.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Anne confirms acceptance
2) Procurement confirms billing details and PO timing
3) Once signed, we provision the credit and flip billing on the agreed start date

Let me know if you want me to lower the token cap or tweak the clawback clause — we can be flexible on timing but would prefer to keep the credit amount fixed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Anne Grosvenor <anne.grosvenor@grosvenortech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@grosvenortech.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood incentive offer for Grosvenor evaluation (formal)

Vanessa — thank you, this looks straightforward and aligned with our needs. Procurement: please confirm PO cadence; we can cut the PO as soon as the DocuSign is back.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Token cap: we accept 250M but can you confirm monitoring and a weekly usage report while the credit is active?
- Clawback: 60 days is acceptable if clearly defined in the DocuSign.

Vanessa, happy to proceed. Please send the DocuSign and we’ll aim to return it within 48 hours.

— Anne
VP Product | Grosvenor Technologies
anne.grosvenor@grosvenortech.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Provisioning note — Grosvenor credit (DEAL-3942)

All — Anne accepted and procurement is ready to sign once DocuSign is sent. I pushed the DocuSign out this afternoon (link: https://www.docusign.com/12345-grosvenor-incentive).

Ben: please provision a $12,000 credit on their account with the following metadata:
- Credit code: GROS-DEC12K-001
- Applies to first invoice after signed start date
- Token cap: 250000000 tokens
- Reporting cadence: weekly usage emails to anne.grosvenor@grosvenortech.com; copy custody to vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
- Clawback: 60 days from invoice date if contract terminated for convenience

Ben — confirm when credit is in place so I can update Anne and procurement.

Thanks team — this should close the Q4 push if sign returns on time.

Vanessa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
